item.title: Follow-up to Carrot disclosure: Forgejo
item.description:
📝 I've learnt that the role of Forgejo security team is to "take care of security vulnerabilities and to handle sensitive security-related issues reported to security@forgejo. Various entities, including some with security teams, revised their judgment about what Forgejo is and isn't, which was the main goal of the previous blogpost. So I ended up sending and email to Forgejo security team, containing: an apology, a bit about my reasoning for proceeding with carrot disclosure, recommendations about what to harden/review, and a bunch of commented exploits/proof-of-concepts as attachment.
🔗 Read more: https://dustri.org/b/follow-up-to-carrot-disclosure-forgejo.html

item.title: American Dads Became the Parents Their Fathers Never Were
item.description:
📝 The new American dad is more present and more exhausted—but also, more satisfied with life. Compared to their Boomer parents, childcare time among Millennial dads has more than doubled. To make time for kids, modern fathers have reduced their daily office work by more than an hour—not to mention, cut down their TV time by 30 minutes—as they pour more of their waking life into being at home.
🔗 Read more: https://www.derekthompson.org/p/why-do-richer-dads-spend-more-time
